states.name: ready
states.userSees: 16:9 player; below it the title, owner row (avatar, channel, subscriber count, subscribe), an action row (like with count, dislike, share, save, more), a description panel with view/date/hashtag line and expander, then comments; a right rail of related videos on desktop (below the fold on narrow screens)

states.name: loading
states.userSees: not captured as a distinct state: the page streams the player shell first and metadata later; no skeleton was observed before the title appeared

states.name: unavailable (restricted)
states.trigger: video blocked by the network's Restricted Mode
states.userSees: authored panel: unavailable heading plus a sentence explaining that the video is restricted by the administrator; the comments area reads that comments are turned off; no player

states.name: error
states.userSees: metadata still renders; no alert or retry appears in the observed window; the player keeps its own error surface

states.name: offline (cold)
states.userSees: the browser's own network error page; the app is not reached

states.name: disabled
states.userSees: like, subscribe, save and comment entry points are present; each leads to an auth surface (not followed); a pre-roll ad and a site promo may cover the player and metadata until dismissed

controls.name: theater mode
controls.behaviour: widens the player from 873 to 1265 px and hides the rail; ~0.26-0.53 s

controls.name: like
controls.ariaLabel: like this video along with <n> other people

controls.name: description expander
controls.behaviour: expands the collapsed panel; measured expanded at 1280 and 390

controls.name: comments
controls.behaviour: desktop renders a count, a sort control, an add-comment entry point and thread list; narrow viewports had no threads in the initial DOM

controls.name: related videos
controls.behaviour: 20 items in the desktop rail, 9 on narrow screens

timingsMeta.method: in-page PerformanceNavigationTiming/Paint/LCP entries; theater latency from click to a >40px player width change
timingsMeta.note: per-frame CLS is not reported: dismissing a pre-roll/promo during capture changed layout and makes the metric incomparable to a clean load

a11y.playerControlNames: explicit and include the keyboard shortcut (e.g. 'Play keyboard shortcut k', 'Theater mode keyboard shortcut t')
a11y.reducedMotion: no running CSS animations reported before or under prefers-reduced-motion (0 and 0)

gaps.question: What is shown while the watch page resolves?
gaps.why: The page streams the player shell and metadata; no skeleton was observed before the title appeared.

gaps.question: Is there an authored error or retry when the player or next-up request fails?
gaps.why: Blocking the endpoints left the metadata rendered with no alert in the observed window; the player's internal error surface was not isolated.

gaps.question: What is the real layout stability of a clean watch load?
gaps.why: Dismissing a pre-roll and a promo during capture changed layout, so the measured CLS is not comparable to a clean load.

gaps.question: What happens on like, subscribe, save and comment?
gaps.why: They lead to an auth surface the guardrails exclude.

gaps.question: How do pre-roll and mid-roll ads change the layout and timing?
gaps.why: A pre-roll appeared on most loads and was skipped to reach the content; ad variants differ and were not measured.

gaps.question: Settings, captions and quality menus
gaps.why: Only their triggers were located; the menus were not opened.

gaps.question: Seek behaviour and chapter markers
gaps.why: The seek slider and time readout were located, not exercised.

gaps.question: Autoplay toggle behaviour
gaps.why: Observed as 'Autoplay is on' but not toggled.

gaps.question: Why does the 390 metadata column measure 427px inside a 375px viewport?
gaps.why: The title and description boxes overflow horizontally; the cause (layout width vs. viewport scaling) was not established.

gaps.question: How do comments load on narrow viewports?
gaps.why: No comment threads were present in the initial 390 DOM; loading may require a further scroll or a dedicated entry point.

gaps.question: Queue, mini-player and up-next autoplay behaviour
gaps.why: Separate Workstream B/C flows; deliberately not covered here.

gaps.question: Which elements depend on region, locale, experiment or ad inventory?
gaps.why: One region and a small set of videos were observed.
